scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join('SKLBCLBP','public','_redirects'); const destDir='public'; const dest=path.join(destDir,'_redirects'); fs.mkdirSync(destDir,{recursive:true}); if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);"
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join('public','_redirects'); const destDir='dist'; const dest=path.join(destDir,'_redirects'); fs.mkdirSync(destDir,{recursive:true}); if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);"
